spec_match.rationale: column-rule/row-rule on the magazine grid, a faithful border-hack fallback mode, and generated CSS that mirrors what is applied all match the css-gaps-1 surface.

interactive.rationale: Style selects, width slider with readout, colour picker, column-count select, gap-vs-border mode toggle and a copy button all drive the live layout and the generated CSS (assessed from code review and the rendered DOM; the controls were not driven in this session).

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises the toggle between gap decorations and border fallback, live style/width/colour adjustment and a copyable snippet — all present.

edge_cases.rationale: The border-fallback generator mishandles the span-2 feature article (last-in-row/last-row arithmetic assumes one cell per article), and there is no live support detection, so in this browser 'gap decorations' mode shows no lines while 'border fallback' does — reading as if the modes were swapped.

references.rationale: Fixed 2026-10-04 (weekly hardening): the page now links https://chromestatus.com/feature/5157805733183488, matching its feature index — restoring invariant 3 and the fix-slugs self-heal. Verified by grep against the canonical id on the feature index.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite covers the real surface and honestly fails 6 of 8 here.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Cloud-fallback observation only, NOT browser-verified per auto-research.md §0 — headless Chromium 141 (full-page screenshot + DOM, not chrome-devtools-mcp): magazine renders rule-less (expected), conformance panel 2/6/0, and the screenshot shows the inactive mode button rendering blank; controls were not driven. chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session (the auto-research.md section-0 blocker applies, so this is NOT browser verification): what was exercised is page load, full-page screenshot read, served/dumped DOM state and the /conformance/ route result; driving every control and capturing console/network evidence remains for an MCP-equipped session.

design_system.rationale: Fixed 2026-10-04 (weekly hardening): .mode-btn now sets color: var(--text-black) with its overridden background, so inactive labels render (invariant 6, bug class 308580a). Verified by screenshot after the fix: all button labels legible in both states; remaining colours are design tokens.

accessibility.rationale: Controls have aria-labels and the slider has a readout, but one mode button is visually illegible, neither exposes aria-pressed, the ≈8px labels are below legible size, and code regeneration/copy feedback is visual-only.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: The magazine caps at 700px and controls wrap; clean at 1280px headless, but three/four text columns at 0.68rem on a 360px screen will be unreadable (untested here).

openQuestions.title: Account for the span-2 feature article in the border-fallback generator
openQuestions.detail: applyBorderFallback() computes last-in-row/last-row by index modulo column count, but the first article spans two columns, so with 3 or 4 columns the borders land on the wrong edges. Track actual cell positions (or temporarily drop the span in fallback mode) so the fallback comparison is honest.

openQuestions.title: Detect support so the two modes don't read backwards
openQuestions.detail: In a pre-support browser, gap mode draws nothing while border mode draws lines — without a notice this looks like the feature mode is broken. Probe CSS.supports('row-rule-color','red') and banner the gap mode as unsupported here, as the honest-capability rule requires.

openQuestions.title: Raise control typography to a legible size
openQuestions.detail: Labels, selects and the copy button run 0.5–0.57rem (≈8–9px). Bring controls to ≥0.7rem and re-check tap-target size (≈44px) for mobile.

summary: Reviewed with the headless-Chromium-141 cloud fallback (not chrome-devtools-mcp): full-page screenshot + DOM of /v149/css-gap-decorations/magazine-layout/ and the feature /conformance/ route (HTTP 200; panel 2 pass / 6 fail / 0 blocked). The most feature-complete interactive surface in this folder (mode toggle, five controls, copyable generated CSS), but it repeats the invariant-6 invisible-button bug on its mode toggle, ships with no ChromeStatus reference, miscomputes the border fallback around the span-2 article, and uses ≈8px control type. Rules do not render in this browser; controls were not driven headless.

guidanceConsulted.query: external reference links list rel noopener semantics
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep target=_blank external links on rel=noopener; no further guidance matched a plain reference-list addition.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the restored ChromeStatus links use target=_blank rel=noopener in the page's existing see-also list pattern; change is a reference-list fix only, no layout/control/CSS behavior touched.

guidanceConsulted.query: visible button state styling when overriding background (design-system contrast)
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Set foreground and background together; never inherit a foreground across an overridden background.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: added color: var(--text-black) beside the overridden background on the inactive button rule (invariant 6), keeping the active state's inverted pair.
